s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominopelvic mass with respiratory symptoms and history of recent pelvic surgery
salient_findings: Fleshy lesion at the vaginal apex
Multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest on PET-CT
Poorly differentiated epithelioid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei in necrosis on biopsy
key_facts: 56-year-old nulliparous woman
14 months after supracervical laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy
Preoperative evaluation included a normal Pap smear
No chest radiograph or endometrial biopsy was obtained preoperatively
Prolonged mechanical morcellation without a containment bag during surgery
Superficial pelvic endometriosis was noted and cauterized during surgery
Final pathology on uterine fragments showed weakly proliferative endometrium without atypia, adenomyosis, and leiomyoma
Ovaries showed benign parenchyma and endosalpingiosis
Patient reports left lower quadrant pain, persistent cough, and shortness of breath
Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma
Immunohistochemical stains were positive for cytokeratin, vimentin, and CD138

shortlist.label: Endometrioid adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Poorly differentiated epithelioid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei in necrosis on biopsy

shortlist.label: Carcinosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of recent pelvic surgery and presence of abdominopelvic mass with respiratory symptoms

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of uterine leiomyomas and recent pelvic surgery

shortlist.label: Malignant mixed Mullerian tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Complex clinical presentation with multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest

raw.rationale: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and immunohistochemical stains were positive for cytokeratin, vimentin, and CD138, which supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and inconsistent histological features

rejected.label: Carcinosarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of both carcinoma and sarcoma components in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Negative immunohistochemical stains for SMA, desmin, and myogenin, which are typical markers for leiomyosarcoma

rejected.label: Malignant mixed Mullerian tumor
rejected.why: No evidence of both epithelial and mesenchymal malignant components in the biopsy results
